name: Princess Juliana International Airport
before:
The main airport for Saint Martin, on the Dutch side of the island in Sint Maarten beside Simpson Bay Lagoon. It is the hub for Winair and the main gateway to the smaller Leeward Islands, including Anguilla, Saba, Saint Barthélemy and Sint Eustatius.

It is famous for the approach over Maho Beach, where arriving aircraft on the final approach to Runway 10 pass very low overhead. It is one of the world's favourite spots for plane spotters.

It is also genuinely dangerous and worth a warning. In 2017 a New Zealand woman died from injuries caused by jet blast from a departing aircraft, and tourists are frequently criticised for behaving recklessly on the beach. A client planning to watch should be told to stay well clear of the fence at the runway end.

The single runway is 2,300 metres. There is a second, smaller airport on the French side of the island, Grand Case-Espérance.

It is named after Queen Juliana of the Netherlands, who landed here in 1944 as heir presumptive, the year after the airport opened.
after:
The main airport for Saint Martin, on the Dutch side of the island in Sint Maarten, at Simpson Bay. It is the hub for Winair and the main connecting airport for the smaller islands nearby, including Anguilla, Saba, Saint Barthélemy and Sint Eustatius.

Most arriving aircraft pass very low over Maho Beach, one of the world's favourite spots for plane spotters.

It is also dangerous and worth a warning. In 2017 a New Zealand woman died after being knocked over by jet blast from a departing aircraft. Tell a client planning to watch to stay well clear of the fence at the runway end.

The single runway is 2,300 metres. There is a second, smaller airport on the French side of the island, Grand Case-Espérance.

It is named after Queen Juliana of the Netherlands, who landed here in 1944 as heir presumptive, the year after the first commercial flight.

The first commercial flight in 1943 is what both sources give.
